text:
Tara: Quick catch from support: ratecard quickcalc still says "per-request" for embeddings. Also the SDK example uses `X-Rate-Limit` (old) and the Grafana link 404s. I opened a small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9400 — can @Owen @Kim take a look?
Owen: Ack. I'll swap the SDK snippets to use `client.usage.fetch_range()` (py/node) and replace raw header names with `X-Usage-Tokens` + `X-Burst-Remaining`. Will add a one-paragraph migration note for v1->v3 header mapping. Pushing in ~15m.
Kim: I'll replace the grafana permalink with the public metering dashboard and update the panel id to `tokens.ingested.total`. I'll open PR for link-fix and run local link-check.
Tara: Support also asked for a tiny copyable calc: "tokens = ceil(chars / 4); cost = (tokens/1000) * $0.05" — can we add that above the quickcalc?
Owen: Adding that calc and a short Python snippet showing tokenizer usage. Keeping a raw-header appendix for advanced integrators.
DocsCI: queued: link-check + examples-smoke for PRs 9400, 9402. lint ok on 9400.
Kim: Link PR 9402 opened and merged (grafana swap). No more 403s locally.
Owen: Pushed snippet + migration note to 9400 and rebased after 9402. Left a comment about burst credit rounding differences.
DocsCI: re-run: examples-smoke (py+node) passed; link-check passed. Ready to merge 9400.
Tara: Merging now. I'll add a short changelog blurb and a support-ready paste: "Embeddings billed per-token; header names updated; public metering dashboard link." Ping here if anything regresses.
DocsCI: merged PR 9400. changelog auto-created and #support notified.
